title: Public Momentus Connect API Now Available – Momentus Connect

Loading...

For developers and technical integrators looking to access API documentation without authentication barriers, our publicly accessible API documentation helps you quickly reference integration details without needing platform credentials.

In this article:

- [What's New](https://connectsupportcenter.ungerboeck.com/hc/en-us/articles/35430168339351-Public-Momentus-Connect-API-Now-Available#h_01K6W9EEQBQNTM5PJVBX22Y941)
- [Key Features](https://connectsupportcenter.ungerboeck.com/hc/en-us/articles/35430168339351-Public-Momentus-Connect-API-Now-Available#h_01K6W9EKSXPCE177TX5KB9P51P)

### What's New

We've made the Momentus Connect API documentation publicly accessible, removing the requirement for users to log in with Enterprise or Elite credentials. This enhancement streamlines the development process by allowing developers to access comprehensive API documentation directly through a public URL without navigating through the authenticated Momentus Connect interface.

The API documentation is now available through a new public route while maintaining the existing authenticated route for logged-in users:

- Americas: [https://connect.gomomentus.com/api-documentation](https://connect.gomomentus.com/api-documentation)
- Canada: [https://connect-ca.gomomentus.com/api-documentation](https://connect-ca.gomomentus.com/api-documentation)
- EMEA: [https://connect-emea.gomomentus.com/api-documentation](https://connect-emea.gomomentus.com/api-documentation)
- APAC: [https://connect-apac.gomomentus.com/api-documentation](https://connect-apac.gomomentus.com/api-documentation)

### Key Features

- Immediate access: View complete API documentation without login credentials
- Improved developer experience: Eliminate friction in the API integration process
- Consistent documentation: Access the same comprehensive content available to authenticated users
- Seamless navigation: Authenticated users can still access documentation through internal links without disrupting their session
